about: Per-body weight budget, KB (1 KB = 1024 bytes) of the raw GLB on disk, for every shipped body in public/assets/manifest-hollow.json (the manifest the build ships). A body is a manifest model whose url is not under weapons/ or cash/ (rigid equipment and props are not bodies). Measured 2026-10-28 on origin/main: 44 bodies: crowd 452-651 KB (19 files), creature NPCs 228-687 KB (11), named hero/hunter/vagrant/hollow 894-3401 KB (7), bosses 1906-2873 KB (7). Crowd and creature caps sit about 8% over the largest current file, so a new crowd body cannot quietly double. Named and boss share Dom's soft cap of about 2 MB (2048 KB) plus a 100 KB tolerance (Dom 2026-10-26: never drop a body for 0.1 MB over), so the hard line is 2148 KB. `exceptions` are bodies already over that line on the day the row landed: each has its own ceiling (current size rounded up to 10 KB) so it can shrink but never grow. They are reported, never deleted. An exception that has dropped under its class line must be removed (the row says so).
firstVisitWireAbout: V3's first-visit wire budget (frankendom-v3 data/build.json firstVisitBytes, COO 2026-10-27, 5.5 MB for the alpha). The gate sums gzip bytes of the bodies that are not `deferred` in manifest-hollow.json (loaded before first input) and fails over this. Measured 2026-10-28: 2 bodies, 2.49 MB gzip. All 44 bodies together are 28.9 MB gzip / 27.3 MB brotli: they stream in after first input, so that total is reported, not gated.
